seoTitle: Third-Party Script Cost by Vendor: HAR and Lighthouse Analysis
metaDescription: Group HAR requests by known vendors such as analytics, ads, chat and tag managers, with bytes and request time per vendor. Also reads the Lighthouse third-party summary.
intro: Maps the third-party requests in a HAR file to known vendors and categories, or reads the Lighthouse third-party summary, to show what each vendor costs.
why:
Tag managers, chat widgets and ad scripts add up, and nobody owns the total. A per-vendor table makes the conversation easier.

For a HAR file the tool uses a hand-made list of well-known domains and reports requests, bytes and request time per vendor and category. The main-thread cost is not in a HAR, so if you paste a Lighthouse report instead, the tool shows the transfer size, main thread time and blocking time that Lighthouse measured. Unknown domains show as unclassified.
howTo: Export a HAR file or a Lighthouse JSON report.
Read the vendor table sorted by bytes.
Check the category totals to find what to remove or delay.

faq.q: How complete is the vendor list?
faq.a: It has about 90 entries for common vendors. Anything else is listed as unclassified with its site name.
Only through the Lighthouse report. A HAR has network data only.

faq.q: Why is a CDN listed as a vendor?
faq.a: Public CDNs and font hosts are third-party requests too, so they are shown with their own category.
